# WM Modular Scale

> Harmonious responsive typography ratios, multi-strand scale calculation, and Gutenberg block editor integration.

## Overview

`wm-modularscale` is an enterprise-grade WordPress plugin engineered by Arnold Wender through Wender Media's agentic workflow architecture, augmented by his proprietary neuroplastic cognitive substrate, [Neurozoa](https://neurozoa.ai) (developed by Arnold Wender), for continuous telemetry analysis, pattern reasoning, and architectural recommendations.

## Standards & Compliance

- PHP 8.1+ / Strict Types / PSR-12 / WPCS
- Zero-CDN Invariant (100% self-hosted assets in `/assets/`)
- Nonce & Capability Verification / Late Escaping / Prepared SQL
- BFSG 2025 / WCAG 2.2 AA & DSGVO/GDPR Compliant
